positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Reduced replication times by up to 40% by designing and implementing an AWS S3-based multipart upload/download system for CSV lookups.
• Decreased network load on the cluster captain by integrating chunking and assembling logic for large CSV files, improving data transfer efficiency.
• Implemented support for large lookup files over 5GB and reduced out-of-sync issues by 25% by utilizing AWS S3 multipart transfer capabilities into the Configuration Replication framework.
• Resolved issues affecting over 123 large customer Splunk stacks by incorporating the changes mentioned above into the Search Head Cluster replication backend workflow.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the transition of Splunk Cloud Services' deployment tool from Bash to Golang, achieving a modular design, swift local testing, and concurrency support for enhanced bug detection.
• Cut deployment testing times by 20% by developing a feature for local application deployment, streamlining the testing process, and reducing the need for full pipeline deployments.
• Designed and implemented an interactive dashboard that computes and displays key DevOps metrics from Splunk Cloud Services’ teams, enhancing visibility into performance, boosting productivity, and facilitating early identification of productivity bottlenecks in the cloud infrastructure organization.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: • Boosted issue triaging efficiency by 30% by creating a bespoke RESTful API for interacting with JIRA services from the company’s internal ticket request system, facilitating seamless software management.

honors.title: William J. Branstrom Freshman Prize
honors.description: First-term freshmen who rank in the upper 5% of their class within their school or college are awarded the William J. Branstrom Freshman Prize.
honors.issuer: Issued by the University of Michigan · Mar 2022

projects.title: Machine Learning Powered Post Categorizer for Online Class Forum
projects.description: Developed a program that uses natural language processing and machine learning techniques to automatically identify the subject of posts from class forum.

projects.title: Famous Monument Image Categorizer
projects.description: Implemented a convolutional neural network model that recognizes and identifies images of landmarks from around the world.
